tweets.text: Desk-job neck tightness has a different shape than post-workout soreness — it builds up slowly instead of hitting all at once. Which is probably why a massage gun hasn't fully fixed it for you.

Shiatsu neck massagers vs. massage guns — not the same tool:
🤖 Massage gun — handheld, one muscle, 1-2 min, built for post-workout soreness
♨️ Shiatsu neck wrap — hands-free, heated, 15-20 min, built for slow-building desk tension
Different problems, different tools.

Before: a massage gun that helps your legs after a workout but does nothing for the knot that builds up during an 8-hour desk day.
After: a heated shiatsu wrap made for exactly that slow-building tightness — kneading nodes instead of tapping.
